-- This script creates 0 alpha meshes for each body part of the custom StarterCharacter

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

local viewport: ViewportFrame = plr.PlayerGui.MaskGui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ViewportFrame")

-- If ViewportFrame wasn't found then wait for it to be added
while not viewport do
	viewport = plr.PlayerGui.MaskGui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ViewportFrame")
	task.wait()
end

-- Only run script for examples which require it
if not viewport:GetAttribute("UseCharacterMask") or viewport.Name == "Character2Viewport" then return end

local useGlassCharMask: boolean = viewport:GetAttribute("UseGlassCharacterMask")

local maskStorage = viewport.CharacterMaskMeshes
local maskClonables = game.ReplicatedStorage.CharacterMaskClonables

-- Normal variants of 0 alpha character meshes
local limbMask: MeshPart = maskClonables.LimbNormal
local torsoMask: MeshPart = maskClonables.TorsoNormal
local headMask: MeshPart = maskClonables.HeadNormal

-- Create table for storing each character mask mesh
local maskMeshes = {}
for _, child in char:GetChildren() do
	if not child:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
	
	local newMesh, originalPart
	if child.Name:match("Head") then
		-- Use normal character meshes for house example
		newMesh = headMask:Clone()
	elseif child.Name:match("Torso") then
		newMesh = torsoMask:Clone()
	elseif child.Name:match("Leg") or child.Name:match("Arm") then
		newMesh = limbMask:Clone()
	else
		continue
	end

	newMesh.CFrame = child.CFrame
	newMesh.Color = child.Color
	newMesh.Material = if useGlassCharMask then Enum.Material.Glass else child.Material
	newMesh.Transparency = if useGlassCharMask then 0.99 else 0
	newMesh.Parent = maskStorage
	
	originalPart = child
	maskMeshes[#maskMeshes + 1] = {newMesh, originalPart}
end

-- When parenting these meshes under a ViewportFrame straight away their movement is delayed
-- Not sure what causes it but parenting to workspace and then back to the frame seems to fix it
maskStorage.Parent = workspace
task.wait()
maskStorage.Parent = viewport

-- Update each characters mesh's CFrame each frame to original part
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	for _, meshInfo in maskMeshes do
		meshInfo[1].CFrame = meshInfo[2].CFrame
	end
end)

-- This script converts the player's character into glass for masking in a ViewportFrame in the shape of the player
-- The glass parts render the 0 alpha planes behind them

if script.Parent.Parent ~= workspace then return end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root: BasePart = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

local viewport: ViewportFrame = plr.PlayerGui.MaskGui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ViewportFrame")

-- If ViewportFrame wasn't found then wait for it to be added
while not viewport do
	viewport = plr.PlayerGui.MaskGui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ViewportFrame")
	task.wait()
end

-- Only run script if current example is Character2 example
if viewport.Name ~= "Character2Viewport" then return end

local worldModel: Folder = viewport.WorldModel

-- Clone character
char.Archivable = true
local newChar = char:Clone()
local newRoot: BasePart = newChar:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
newChar.Parent = worldModel

-- Convert all MeshParts in cloned character to glass for revealing mask to work
for _, desc in newChar:GetDescendants() do
	if desc:IsA("Clothing") or desc:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or desc:IsA("Decal") then desc:Destroy() continue end
	if not desc:IsA("MeshPart") then continue end

	desc.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	desc.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
	desc.Transparency = 0.99

	-- Remove SurfaceAppearance
	for _, child in desc:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then child:Destroy() end
	end
	desc.TextureID = ""

	originalPart = desc
end

local newMotor6DTable: {Motor6D} = {}
for _, desc in ipairs(newChar:GetDescendants()) do
	if desc:IsA("Motor6D") then
		table.insert(newMotor6DTable, desc)
	end
end

local mainMotor6DTable: {Motor6D} = {}
for _, desc in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
	if desc:IsA("Motor6D") then
		table.insert(mainMotor6DTable, desc)
	end
end

-- Update cloned character's Motor6Ds to match real character's animations
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	newRoot.CFrame = root.CFrame
	
	for i, newMotor6D: Motor6D in newMotor6DTable do
		local mainMotor6D = mainMotor6DTable[i]
		newMotor6D.C1 = mainMotor6D.C1 * mainMotor6D.Transform:Inverse()
	end
end)

local animateScript = newChar:WaitForChild("Animate", 2)
if animateScript then animateScript:Destroy() end

function configureAnimationSet(name, fileList)
	if (animTable[name] ~= nil) then
		for _, connection in pairs(animTable[name].connections) do
			connection:disconnect()
		end
	end
	animTable[name] = {}
	animTable[name].count = 0
	animTable[name].totalWeight = 0	
	animTable[name].connections = {}

	-- check for config values
	local config = script:FindFirstChild(name)
	if (config ~= nil) then
--		print("Loading anims " .. name)
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildAdded:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildRemoved:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		local idx = 1
		for _, childPart in pairs(config:GetChildren()) do
			if (childPart:IsA("Animation")) then
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.Changed:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				animTable[name][idx] = {}
				animTable[name][idx].anim = childPart
				local weightObject = childPart:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if (weightObject == nil) then
					animTable[name][idx].weight = 1
				else
					animTable[name][idx].weight = weightObject.Value
				end
				animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
				animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + animTable[name][idx].weight
	--			print(name .. " [" .. idx .. "] " .. animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId .. " (" .. animTable[name][idx].weight .. ")")
				idx = idx + 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- fallback to defaults
	if (animTable[name].count <= 0) then
		for idx, anim in pairs(fileList) do
			animTable[name][idx] = {}
			animTable[name][idx].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			animTable[name][idx].anim.Name = name
			animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId = anim.id
			animTable[name][idx].weight = anim.weight
			animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
			animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + anim.weight
--			print(name .. " [" .. idx .. "] " .. anim.id .. " (" .. anim.weight .. ")")
		end
	end
end

function setAnimationSpeed(speed)

function keyFrameReachedFunc(frameName)
	if (frameName == "End") then

		local repeatAnim = currentAnim
		-- return to idle if finishing an emote
		if (emoteNames[repeatAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[repeatAnim] == false) then
			repeatAnim = "idle"
		end
		
		local animSpeed = currentAnimSpeed
		playAnimation(repeatAnim, 0.0, Humanoid)
		setAnimationSpeed(animSpeed)
	end
end

-- Preload animations
function playAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid) 
		
	local roll = math.random(1, animTable[animName].totalWeight) 
	local origRoll = roll
	local idx = 1
	while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do
		roll = roll - animTable[animName][idx].weight
		idx = idx + 1
	end
--		print(animName .. " " .. idx .. " [" .. origRoll .. "]")
	local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

	-- switch animation		
	if (anim ~= currentAnimInstance) then
		
		if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			currentAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		end

		currentAnimSpeed = 1.0
	
		-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
		currentAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
		currentAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
		 
		-- play the animation
		currentAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
		currentAnim = animName
		currentAnimInstance = anim

		-- set up keyframe name triggers
		if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
			currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
		end
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler = currentAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		
	end

end

		local idx = 1
		while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do

		end
--		print(animName .. " * " .. idx .. " [" .. origRoll .. "]")
		local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

			if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then

				toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
				transitionTime = 0
			end
					
			-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
			toolAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
			if priority then
				toolAnimTrack.Priority = priority
			end
			 
			-- play the animation

			toolAnimName = animName
			toolAnimInstance = anim

			currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler = toolAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(toolKeyFrameReachedFunc)
		end
end

	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
	RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(3.14 /2)
	LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(-3.14 /2)
	RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(3.14 /2)
	LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-3.14 /2)
end

local lastTick = 0

function move(time)
	local amplitude = 1
	local frequency = 1
  	local deltaTime = time - lastTick
  	lastTick = time

	local climbFudge = 0
	local setAngles = false

  	if (jumpAnimTime > 0) then
  		jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimTime - deltaTime
  	end

	if (pose == "FreeFall" and jumpAnimTime <= 0) then
		playAnimation("fall", fallTransitionTime, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Seated") then
		playAnimation("sit", 0.5, Humanoid)
		return
	elseif (pose == "Running") then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.1, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Dead" or pose == "GettingUp" or pose == "FallingDown" or pose == "Seated" or pose == "PlatformStanding") then
--		print("Wha " .. pose)
		stopAllAnimations()
		amplitude = 0.1
		frequency = 1
		setAngles = true
	end

	if (setAngles) then
		local desiredAngle = amplitude * math.sin(time * frequency)

		RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(desiredAngle + climbFudge)
		LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(desiredAngle - climbFudge)
		RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(-desiredAngle)
		LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-desiredAngle)
	end

	-- Tool Animation handling
	local tool = getTool()
	if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
	
		local animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(tool)

		if animStringValueObject then
			toolAnim = animStringValueObject.Value
			-- message recieved, delete StringValue
			animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
			toolAnimTime = time + .3
		end

		if time > toolAnimTime then
			toolAnimTime = 0
			toolAnim = "None"
		end

		animateTool()		
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		toolAnim = "None"
		toolAnimInstance = nil
		toolAnimTime = 0
	end
end

-- Hide a single object or its descendants
local function ToggleSelected(object: BasePart | Model | Folder, visible: boolean, hideButton: ImageButton)
	if object:IsA("BasePart") then
		-- If material is glass transparency should be 0.99 to decrease ViewportFrame light reflections
		if object.Material == Enum.Material.Glass then
			object.Transparency = if visible then 0.99 else 1
		else
			object.Transparency = if visible then 0 else 1
		end
	elseif object:IsA("Model") or object:IsA("Folder") then
		for _, desc in object:GetDescendants() do
			if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
				if desc.Material == Enum.Material.Glass then
					desc.Transparency = if visible then 0.99 else 1
				else
					desc.Transparency = if visible then 0 else 1
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	hideButton.ImageLabel.Disabled.Visible = not visible
	hideButton:SetAttribute("Visible", visible)
end

-- When holding ctrl hide / show all except selected
local function ToggleAllExceptSelected(object: BasePart | Model | Folder, visible: boolean, hideButton: ImageButton)
	ToggleSelected(object, visible, hideButton)
	for _, child in object.Parent:GetChildren() do
		if child == object then
			continue
		end
		
		-- Skip if child doesn't have a hide button
		local hideChildButton = hideButton.Parent:FindFirstChild("Hide//" .. child.Name)
		if not hideChildButton then continue end
		
		-- If selected is visible then other objects are invisible
		ToggleSelected(child, not visible, hideChildButton)
	end
end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local rng = Random.new()
local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local viewport: ViewportFrame = script.Parent
local texture: SurfaceAppearance = viewport.MaskPlane.SurfaceAppearance
local image: EditableImage = Instance.new("EditableImage")
image.Parent = texture

local maskSize = 256
local circleSize = 10 -- Circle starting size
local circleSizeIncrement = 5 -- Amount each button press changes circle size
local circleMinSize, circleMaxSize = 1, maskSize
local mouseDown = false
local mouseInFrame = false
local drawMode: "Erase" | "Draw" = "Erase"

image.Size = Vector2.new(maskSize, maskSize)
local emptyTable = table.create(maskSize^2 * 4, 0)
image:WritePixels(Vector2.zero, image.Size, emptyTable)

-- Converts red pixles to black transparent pixels ie erases mask and draws the image below
local function DrawOnRedPixels(x, y)
	local position = Vector2.new(x - circleSize - 1, y - circleSize - 1)
	local size = Vector2.new(x + circleSize * 2 + 2, y + circleSize * 2 + 2)
	
	local pixels = image:ReadPixels(Vector2.zero, image.Size)
	for i = 1, image.Size.X * image.Size.Y do
		local pixelIndex = 1 + ((i - 1) * 4)
		
		if pixels[pixelIndex] > 0 then
			pixels[pixelIndex] = 0
			pixels[pixelIndex + 1] = 0
			pixels[pixelIndex + 2] = 0
			pixels[pixelIndex + 3] = 0
		end
	end
	image:WritePixels(Vector2.zero, image.Size, pixels)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not mouseDown or not mouseInFrame then return end
	
	local x = math.clamp(((mouse.X - viewport.AbsolutePosition.X) / viewport.AbsoluteSize.X) * image.Size.X, 0, image.Size.X)
	local y = math.clamp(((mouse.Y - viewport.AbsolutePosition.Y) / viewport.AbsoluteSize.Y) * image.Size.Y, 0, image.Size.Y)
	
	if drawMode == "Draw" then
		image:DrawCircle(Vector2.new(x, y), circleSize, Color3.new(1,0,0), 0)
		DrawOnRedPixels(x, y)
	else
		image:DrawCircle(Vector2.new(x, y), circleSize, Color3.new(0,0,0), 0)
	end
	
	-- Trigger viewport refresh
	viewport.Refresh.Position = rng:NextUnitVector()
end)

viewport.MouseEnter:Connect(function() mouseInFrame = true end)
viewport.MouseLeave:Connect(function() mouseInFrame = false end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gameProcessedEvent: boolean)
	if gameProcessedEvent then return end
	
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		mouseDown = true
		return
	end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
		drawMode = "Draw"
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gameProcessedEvent: boolean)
	if gameProcessedEvent then return end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		mouseDown = false
		return
	end
	
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
		drawMode = "Erase"
		return
	end
	
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
		circleSize = math.min(circleSize + circleSizeIncrement, circleMaxSize)
		return
	end
	
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then
		circleSize = math.max(circleSize - circleSizeIncrement, circleMinSize)
		return
	end
end)

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local rng = Random.new()
local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

local distanceFromFocus = 6 -- Distance of model in studs from focus point

local galaxyPlane: Model = script.Parent.GalaxyMask
local stars1: MeshPart, stars2: MeshPart = galaxyPlane:WaitForChild("Stars1"), galaxyPlane:WaitForChild("Stars2")
local galaxy1: MeshPart, galaxy2: MeshPart = galaxyPlane:WaitForChild("Galaxy1"), galaxyPlane:WaitForChild("Galaxy2")
local planes: {MeshPart} = {stars1, galaxy1, stars2, galaxy2}
local zOffset = {-0.002, -0.001, 0.001, 0.002}

-- Repositions plane attachments so that they loop
local function LoopPlanes()
	local origin = galaxyPlane.WorldPivot.Position
	for i, plane: MeshPart in planes do
		local size = planes[i].Size / 2
		local localOffset = plane.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(plane.Position - origin)
		local x, y = (localOffset.X + size.X / 2) % size.X - size.X / 2, (localOffset.Y + size.Y / 2) % size.Y - size.Y / 2
		local worldOffset = plane.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(x, y, zOffset[i]))
		plane.Position = origin + worldOffset
	end
end

local currentTime = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	currentTime += deltaTime
	local distance = (cam.Focus.Position - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
	
	if script.Parent:GetAttribute("UpdateCrossHatchPlane") == false then return end
	
	galaxyPlane:PivotTo(CFrame.new(cam.Focus.Position + cam.CFrame.LookVector * script.Parent:GetAttribute("PlaneDistance"), cam.CFrame.Position))
	galaxyPlane:ScaleTo(math.max((distance + distanceFromFocus) / 2, 0.01))
	local currentSizeMultiplier = galaxyPlane:GetScale()
	
	stars1.Position += stars1.CFrame.UpVector * deltaTime * currentSizeMultiplier * 0.4
	stars2.Position += stars2.CFrame.UpVector * deltaTime * currentSizeMultiplier * 0.2
	galaxy1.Position += galaxy1.CFrame.RightVector * deltaTime * currentSizeMultiplier * 0.08
	galaxy2.Position += galaxy2.CFrame.UpVector * deltaTime * currentSizeMultiplier * 0.05
	LoopPlanes()
end)

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local rng = Random.new()

local viewport: ViewportFrame = script.Parent
local cube1: Model = viewport.Cube1
local cube2: Model = viewport.Cube2
local letters = {}
for _, child: MeshPart in viewport.Text:GetChildren() do
	letters[tonumber(child.Name)] = child
end

local upDownCycleTime = 3 -- Time it takes to make a full up and down cycle
local upDownDistance = 0.4 -- Maximum distance from y = 0 the letters go up and down
local timeOffset = 0.07 -- Time offset between each consecutive letter
local noiseSpeed = 1 -- Speed of 1d perlin noise used to randomly rotate letters
local maxPitchAngle = 45 -- Maximum angles for letters
local maxYawAngle = 45
local maxRollAngle = 45
local cube1SpinTime = 11 -- Time it takes to make a full spin for cube 1
local cube2SpinTime = 6 -- Time it takes to make a full spin for cube 2

local currentTime = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime: number)
	currentTime += deltaTime
	
	for i, letter: MeshPart in letters do
		local pos = letter.Position
		local height = math.sin((currentTime / upDownCycleTime + i * timeOffset) * 2 * math.pi) * upDownDistance
		
		local pitch = math.rad(math.noise(currentTime * noiseSpeed + i * 5000) * maxPitchAngle)
		local yaw = math.rad(math.noise(0, currentTime * noiseSpeed + i * 5000) * maxYawAngle)
		local roll = math.rad(math.noise(0, 0, currentTime * noiseSpeed + i * 5000) * maxRollAngle)
		
		letter.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(pos.X, height, pos.Z)) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, yaw, roll)
	end

	cube1:PivotTo(CFrame.new(cube1.WorldPivot.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, -math.rad(360 / cube1SpinTime) * currentTime, 0))
	cube2:PivotTo(CFrame.new(cube2.WorldPivot.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(360 / cube2SpinTime) * currentTime, 0))
end)

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local rng = Random.new()
local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

local worldModel: WorldModel = script.Parent.WorldModel
local sphereStorage: Folder = worldModel.PortalSpheres
local mainPortalSphere: MeshPart = worldModel.MainPortalSphere

local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {sphereStorage}

local sphereSpawnTime = 0.2
local spawnTimeVariance = 0.04
local sphereLifetime = 3
local lifetimeVariance = 0.5
local minDistance, maxDistance = 10, 18

local sizeEasing = Enum.EasingStyle.Quad
local sizeEasingDir = Enum.EasingDirection.In
local posEasing = Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
local posEasingDir = Enum.EasingDirection.Out

-- Spawn a single portal sphere and begin animating it
local function SpawnSphere()
	local newSphere = mainPortalSphere:Clone()
	newSphere.Parent = sphereStorage
	newSphere.Size *= 0.8
	
	-- Create both size and position tween for sphere and play them
	local randomPos = rng:NextUnitVector() * rng:NextNumber(minDistance, maxDistance)
	local tweenTime = sphereLifetime + rng:NextNumber(-lifetimeVariance, lifetimeVariance)
	local sizeTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(tweenTime, sizeEasing, sizeEasingDir)
	local posTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(tweenTime, posEasing, posEasingDir)
	local sizeTween = TweenService:Create(newSphere, sizeTweenInfo, {Size = Vector3.zero})
	local posTween = TweenService:Create(newSphere, posTweenInfo, {Position = randomPos + newSphere.Position})
	sizeTween:Play()
	posTween:Play()

	-- Destroy sphere once size tween has ended
	sizeTween.Completed:Once(function() newSphere:Destroy() end)
end

		-- Spawn a portal sphere
		SpawnSphere()
		
		currentTime = 0
		currentVariance = rng:NextNumber(-spawnTimeVariance, spawnTimeVariance)
	end
end)

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local rng = Random.new()

local viewport: ViewportFrame = script.Parent
local wavyTextMesh: MeshPart = viewport.WavyTextMask.WavyTextMesh
local bubbleClonable: Part = viewport.BubbleClonable

local horizontalWaveSpeed = 3 -- How fast horizontal waves move
local horizontalWaveFreq = 15 -- Frequency of horizontal waves
local horizontalWaveAmp = 0.01 -- Amplitude of vertical waves
local verticalWaveSpeed = 2 -- How fast vertical waves move
local verticalWaveFreq = 2 -- Frequency of vertical waves
local verticalWaveAmp = 0.04 -- Amplitude of vertical waves
local bubbleSpawnDelayRange = Vector2.new(0.07, 0.13)
local bubbleSizeRange = Vector2.new(0.15, 0.8)
local bubbleTimeOnScreenRange = Vector2.new(1, 1.8)
local bubbleWavingSpeedRange = Vector2.new(5, 8)
local bubbleWavingAmplitude = 0.1

-- Set OriginalPosition attribute for each bone
local bones: {Bone} = wavyTextMesh:GetChildren()
for _, bone in bones do
	bone:SetAttribute("OriginalPosition", bone.WorldPosition)
end

-- Creates single bubble and handles its animation and destruction
local function CreateBubble()
	local bubble = bubbleClonable:Clone()
	local startPos = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-2, 2), -1.5, rng:NextNumber(-1.4, -1.2))
	
	local size = rng:NextNumber(bubbleSizeRange.X, bubbleSizeRange.Y)
	local timeOnScreen = rng:NextNumber(bubbleTimeOnScreenRange.X, bubbleTimeOnScreenRange.Y)
	local waveSpeed = rng:NextNumber(bubbleWavingSpeedRange.X, bubbleWavingSpeedRange.Y)

	bubble.Size = Vector3.new(size, size, 0.01)
	bubble.Parent = viewport.Bubbles
	
	-- Start animating bubble in RenderStepped function
	local currentLifetime = 0
	local bubbleAnimateConnection: RBXScriptConnection
	bubbleAnimateConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime: number)
		currentLifetime += deltaTime
		local alpha = currentLifetime / timeOnScreen
		
		-- Destroy bubble and its animation connection if it has reached y level of 1 or over
		if bubble.Position.Y >= 1 then
			bubble:Remove()
			bubbleAnimateConnection:Disconnect()
			return
		end
		
		local y = -1.5 - (-1.5 - 1.5) * alpha -- Lerp from -1.5 to 1.5 with alpha to get current y
		local waveOffset = Vector3.new(math.sin(currentLifetime * waveSpeed) * bubbleWavingAmplitude, y, 0)
		bubble.Position = startPos + waveOffset
	end)
end

local currentTime = 0
local waveTime = 0
local currentDelay = rng:NextNumber(bubbleSpawnDelayRange.X, bubbleSpawnDelayRange.Y)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime: number)
	currentTime += deltaTime
	if currentTime >= currentDelay then
		CreateBubble()
		currentTime = 0
		currentDelay = rng:NextNumber(bubbleSpawnDelayRange.X, bubbleSpawnDelayRange.Y)
	end
	
	if viewport:GetAttribute("UpdateTextWaving") then
		waveTime += deltaTime
		for _, bone in bones do
			local originalPosition: Vector3 = bone:GetAttribute("OriginalPosition")
			local xWaveOffset = math.sin(waveTime * horizontalWaveSpeed + originalPosition.Y * horizontalWaveFreq) * horizontalWaveAmp
			local yWaveOffset = math.sin(waveTime * verticalWaveSpeed + originalPosition.X * verticalWaveFreq) * verticalWaveAmp
			bone.WorldPosition = originalPosition + Vector3.new(xWaveOffset, yWaveOffset, 0)
		end
	end
end)

Name: TextRow
Text: ViewportFrame masking can be used for proper occlusion like for the house in this example.

Name: TextRow
Text: House 1 mask (left house), player mask, sky mask and baseplate mask are all made with 0 alpha meshes.

Name: TextRow
Text: These masks don't render anything behind them which creates proper occlusion for things in the ViewportFrame. The two cubes hovewer aren't masked out which is why they appear below the ViewportFrame.

Name: TextRow
Text: Glass parts can be used to show 0 alpha meshes behind them. Thats how this example can show the two cubes rotating behind the letters.

Name: TextRow
Text: In other words glass parts basically add to the mask rather than take away from it like 0 alpha meshes do.

Name: TextRow
Text: This example also shows how decals, textures and mesh textures don't inherit the masking ability of 0 alpha meshes. SurfaceAppearances do however which is why they don't appear outside the letters.

Name: TextRow
Text: The player character can be converted to glass and be used to reveal 0 alpha meshes behind it.

Name: TextRow
Text: By doing so you can create effects such as cross hatching in the shape of the player character.

Name: TextRow
Text: However this effect will appear over everything as ViewportFrame UIs do. Using masks for objects in Workspace will help mitigate this issue but will worsen the effect as seen in example.

Name: TextRow
Text: Since a SurfaceAppearance parented under 0 alpha meshes inherits their masking capabilities, it can be used to mask out parts of a ViewportFrame.

Name: TextRow
Text: When SurfaceAppearance AlphaMode is on transparency the opaque parts of it will masks out anything in the ViewportFrame while the transparent parts won't.

Name: TextRow
Text: SurfaceAppearances only support 5 levels of transparency which will cause transparency banding with mask images which have different levels of transparency.

Name: TextRow
Text: You can also create an EditableImage under a 0 alpha mask's SurfaceAppearance.

Name: TextRow
Text: This way you can use the EditableImage as the mask and for example draw in / out the ViewportFrame behind the mask.

Name: TextRow
Text: A problem though is that the 0 alpha meshes in this hidden world will mask out the glass parts that are behind them. Also decals, textures, mesh textures and transparency isn't supported within this map.

Name: TextRow
Text: I haven't yet figured out a way to utilize this method for an actually traversable portal.

Name: TextRow
Text: Glass parts can be used to reveal a map made out of 0 alpha meshes.

Name: TextRow
Text: A 0 alpha plane mesh can be used to hide a map thats been split in half along this plane. When a doorway gets placed in the middle of this plane a sort of a portal forms.

Name: TextRow
Text: I haven't yet come up with an idea how to use this for a portal but I think this method shows great promise.

Name: TextRow
Text: A ViewportFrame in a ScreenGui can be used for reflections along a plane by masking out parts of this ViewportFrame with masks made out of player's character and other objects within Workspace.

Name: TextRow
Text: Having to constantly update moving objects both in the mirror image and as masks can get performance heavy.

Name: TextRow
Text: Skinned meshes also work as 0 alpha masks which lets you create animatable masks.

Name: TextRow
Text: Another way to animate masks would be to use EditableMeshes but they aren't supported in ViewportFrames yet.

Name: TextRow
Text: Skinned meshes can also be made out of transparent glass. That way they can be used to reveal 0 alpha meshes behind them like in the previous Text Example.

Name: TextRow
Text: Any R15 character can be used for this example as long as its parts can be converted to glass. Otherwise this example is the same as Character1 example

Name: TextRow
Text: Since you cannot set material to player heads and thus cannot set them to glass, they won't work with the masking method used in this example.
